The main living level is anchored by a kitchen finished with KitchenAid appliances, Abodian custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a full pantry - the kind of kitchen that has you looking for any excuse to have people over. The living and dining areas flow freely from there, with a private deck just off the main floor for morning coffee or an evening glass of wine. The top floor is where the home settles into calm. The primary suite has its own corner, a walk-in closet, and a full ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms and a second full bath complete the level. Moments from E Madison dining, Spinasse, Harvest Vine, and Skillet, and minutes from Washington Park Arboretum and the 520 bridge. Madison Valley living, done right. Come experience it yourself.

Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street, this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers an exceptional blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience on a generous 8,500-square-foot lot. Surrounded by mature trees and established landscaping, the property offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of West Seattle. Natural light fills the inviting interior, where thoughtful updates, contemporary finishes, and a comfortable flow between living spaces create a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The updated kitchen combines modern style with everyday functionality, while tastefully finished bathrooms and refined details throughout give the home a fresh, cohesive feel. Modern comforts include a heat pump with central A/C, tankless hot water, and integrated smart-home technology. The spacious, private backyard provides an inviting setting for outdoor entertaining, gardening, and everyday relaxation. A generous patio and mature landscaping enhance the sense of privacy, while the covered carport, ample parking, and additional storage add practicality. This peaceful residential setting offers the best of both worlds-quiet neighborhood living with convenient access to parks, shopping, dining, and RapidRide transit connecting to downtown Seattle and beyond.

Space, versatility, and a sought-after Queen Anne setting come together in this home near the conveniences of Queen Anne and Fremont. Perched above the street, a covered front porch opens to a welcoming main level with living and family rooms, formal dining, a kitchen, one bedroom, and one bath. Two additional bedrooms and a bath occupy the upper level, with access to a large deck perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. The lower level includes its own entrance, a second kitchen, two bedrooms, one bath, a family room, and a utility room. Enjoy the convenience of a rare two-car garage plus additional parking off the alley. Ample storage, flexible living spaces, and LR3 zoning add to the appeal of this well-located property. Come see this house today!

First time on the market in 60 years! Sited on a quiet residential street in the coveted Admiral district, this 1926, 3340 SQFT Craftsman is ready for your creativity and vision. Flooded with natural light and rich with vintage charm, the main level circular floor plan lives large. Upon entry, one is struck by the spaciousness of the living and formal dining room, oak hardwood floors, coved ceilings, traditional millwork, and fireplace. An original kitchen with breakfast nook plus 2 generously sized bedrooms complete the main level. The 2nd floor offers 3 additional large bedrooms, including a primary suite with shared 1/2 bath. The basement has good ceiling height, with additional exterior access, providing potential for a possible ADU (Buyer to verify). Currently the basement presents a finished family room, spanning the width of the house, laundry, storage, gas forced air furnace and gas water heater. Peace-of-mind updates include a newer roof, updated windows and solar panels (installed March 2024) Enjoy a sunny and level yard with alley access and covered parking. Best of all you are only 2 blocks from all that vibrant California Avenue has to offer; putting schools, parks, coffee houses, restaurants, local markets, boutique shops and the Junction's Sunday Farmer's market within minutes of your home. Enjoy a Walk Score of 87.

text: Experience the perfect blend of modern luxury and Pacific Northwest style in this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom Maple Leaf home. Thoughtfully rebuilt with exceptional attention to detail, this residence welcomes you with an open-concept design, beautiful hardwood floors, and light-filled living spaces ideal for everyday comfort and elegant entertaining.The gourmet chef's kitchen is a showstopper, featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a premium Bertazzoni range complemented by a convenient pot filler. Integrated Alexa and Lutron Caseta smart-home technology bring modern convenience and effortless control to your fingertips.Extend your living outdoors to the impressive 200+ sq. ft. heated, covered entertaining deck, complete with gas hookup-perfect for year-round enjoyment.Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, featuring custom closets and a beautifully appointed, European-inspired ensuite bath with heated floors. A second spa-inspired bathroom showcases elegant Grohe fixtures, while a main floor laundry adds everyday convenience.Set on an expansive 5,641 sq. ft. lot, the property offers a fully fenced yard and an exceptional combination of parking and storage rarely found in Seattle: a two-car garage plus additional boat and RV parking.

Welcome to this charming four-bedroom, two-bath cottage tucked along a quiet North Queen Anne street. Newer exterior paint and a level entry welcome you home, while the layout offers two bedrooms and one bathroom on each floor, providing flexibility for guests, work or hobbies. The kitchen features a gas range, and a gas furnace heats the home. Outside, mature landscaping creates a sense of shade and privacy, and a drip irrigation system helps care for the greenery. Enjoy the neighborhood setting just one block from Queen Anne Avenue, with parks, tennis, shopping and dining close by. SPU is nearby, and downtown Seattle, Fremont, South Lake Union and UW are all within easy reach. Settle in and make this inviting cottage your own.

A garden with more than 50 varieties of plants and trees brings seasonal color to this move-in-ready, two-bedroom, one-bath North Seattle home. Inside, the single-level layout features a spacious living room, a functional kitchen, and a dedicated laundry area. The front yard is fully fenced, and the partially fenced backyard offers room to garden, dine outdoors, or relax among the trees. A covered carport provides sheltered parking, and two outbuildings offer extra space for bikes, tools, and garden gear. Walk to Lake City Way for shopping, dining, and transit, with easy access to neighborhood parks, the Burke-Gilman Trail, Lake Washington, and I-5.

Amazing Value in Lakeridge! Incredible opportunity to own in the highly desirable Lakeridge community, offering breathtaking views, exceptional indoor-outdoor living, and an unbeatable location! This charming home features desirable one-level living with expansive bonus space in the lower level. Step inside to discover an abundance of natural light illuminating the spacious living and dining areas, where stunning views create the perfect backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. The inviting living room features a cozy fireplace, while the dining area flows seamlessly into the kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances. Downstairs, discover endless possibilities with a generous second living area, convenient utility room, and versatile bonus space. Step outside to your own private oasis, surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds and featuring an incredible outdoor kitchen and covered patio, perfect for year-round entertaining and enjoying the Pacific Northwest lifestyle. Ideally situated just moments from Lake Washington, scenic parks, excellent schools, and endless amenities. Enjoy convenient access to downtown Seattle, the Eastside, Sea-Tac Airport, Boeing's Renton facility, The Landing, and the vibrant shops and restaurants of Columbia City. A rare opportunity to enjoy breathtaking views, peaceful surroundings, and exceptional convenience in one of Seattle's most desirable communities.

Showcasing breathtaking Puget Sound views, this truly one-of-a-kind Alki residence blends privacy, elegance, and timeless Northwest living-all within walking distance of Alki Beach's shops, restaurants, waterfront, and shoreline. The expansive main level features an oversized view terrace, soaring ceilings, open-concept living spaces, and a beautifully appointed chef's kitchen with generous counter space, abundant custom cabinetry, and premium appliances throughout. A main-floor bedroom, full bath, and formal dining area add both functionality and comfort. Upstairs, the stunning entertaining room is framed by dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows and custom built-ins, with seamless access to an expansive view deck offering panoramic Puget Sound vistas and exceptional space for hosting or relaxing. An adjacent flex nook creates the perfect opportunity for a private wine bar, cocktail lounge, or reading retreat. The luxurious primary suite features dual vanities, an expansive spa-inspired walk-in shower, and an exceptional boutique-style walk-in closet and dressing room. Outside, the serene, park-like grounds are complemented by a sprawling rear entertaining deck, creating the perfect setting for an elevated outdoor retreat surrounded by nature.

Some homes have a character and sense of place that simply can't be recreated. Nestled along the historic Queen Anne Boulevard Loop, this beautiful 5-bedroom, 3-bath home captures the timeless appeal of one of Seattle's most treasured neighborhoods. Graceful, tree-lined streets, lush mature landscaping, and classic architectural details create a setting that feels like a retreat in the heart of the city.Inside, old-world charm meets modern comfort. A beautifully updated kitchen brings fresh energy to the home, while inviting living spaces and a versatile floor plan offer room for everyone. Three bedrooms upstairs, a main-level bedroom, and additional lower-level living space provide wonderful options for guests, working from home, or multigenerational living. And for wine lovers, the impressive wine cellar is a feature all its own!Outside, established gardens create a lovely backdrop for outdoor entertaining, quiet mornings, and everyday enjoyment. A beautiful detached garage adds even more possibilities for parking, hobbies, or a workshop.Rich in history, surrounded by natural beauty, and designed for the way we live today, this is more than a home. It's an opportunity to enjoy the very best of classic Queen Anne living.

Striking architecture. Rich textures. Sweeping skyline views. This Capitol Hill townhome pairs refined modern design with warmth and character on a residential street near vibrant dining, shops and transit. Built in 2021, its open main level features exposed brick, expansive windows and white oak hardwoods. The sleek kitchen offers quartz counters, walnut and black cabinetry, and stainless appliances. A bright guest bedroom features custom built-ins and a walk-in closet, with a full bath nearby. The entire third floor is a private primary retreat, complete with a generous California-style walk-in closet and ensuite bath with walk-in shower. Above it all, a west-facing rooftop deck captures downtown and mountain views for unforgettable evenings. Abundant storage, mini-split heating and cooling, and off-street parking complete this exceptional urban home.

Beautifully restored classic Wallingford Craftsman, built in 1912 and remodeled from the studs out. High ceilings, inlaid oak hardwoods, and box-beam ceilings greet you, and the quality of the restoration makes the whole home feel warm and solid. From the front porch you get sweeping views of the University District, Lake Union, the Cascades, and the Bellevue skyline. A spacious living room flows into a front office or flex space, and the elegant dining room opens to the remodeled kitchen. The main floor has two bedrooms and a full bath. Downstairs, the finished basement adds two more bedrooms and a half bath and is fully waterproofed for real peace of mind. The big updates are already done and updated plumbing and electrical. Out back, the private fenced yard is made for entertaining, with a hot tub and plenty of room to relax. A detached one-car garage with a power opener rounds it out. Parks, the Burke-Gilman Trail, Gas Works, 45th, and UW are all close by, in one of Seattle's most sought-after neighborhoods. It's a true classic, ready for you to move in.

**WELCOME HOME!** A fresh start awaits you at this new construction Seattle home! Step inside to an inviting, open-concept main floor with a spacious living area, functional kitchen with a peninsula, and convenient half bath. Upstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a separate laundry area with washer/dryer hookups. Enjoy energy-efficient mini-split heating and cooling year-round. Offering 997 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this newly built two-story home is ideal for easy, low-maintenance living. Conveniently located just minutes from Northgate shopping and dining, the light rail, Virgil Flaim Park, and I-5.
